artifacts.title: Activation & Audience — Strategic Brainstorm
artifacts.summary: Strategic reframing of activation problem. Cancer as primary life moment to own. Three pillars (Clarity/Convenience/Connection) mapped to Sense of Coherence framework. Four layers of patient need (informational, psychological, relational, existential). Three workstreams: fix funnel, deepen cancer journey, make sharing effortless. Research-backed emotional promises.

artifacts.title: Unicorn Thesis — The Consumer Layer in Healthcare
artifacts.summary: VC-perspective analysis of unicorn path. Care Graph as the defensible moat (not AI). Competitive landscape: Big Tech entering health AI (Apple Health+, ChatGPT Health, Copilot Health) but none building social care layer. EHDS as regulatory tailwind. GTM: cancer in NL → EU expansion via insurer partnerships. Network effect math: 1 patient → 4 circle members. Revenue: B2C + B2B2C + EHDS data services. AI as connective tissue, not chatbot.

artifacts.title: Care Circle v2

artifacts.title: Voice Health Check-in

artifacts.title: Onboarding to Aha
artifacts.summary: BIGB-335 refinement. 6 creative directions for bridging install-to-first-value gap. Primary recommendation: 'Tell Ditto About Your Health' (voice-first health overview using core AI). Includes RISCE scoring, multi-perspective review, and 2-week validation plan.

artifacts.title: Activation Improvement — Voice & Roast Sesh Synthesis
artifacts.summary: Meeting synthesis (Merlijn + Nick, 2026-03-06). Activation funnel data (90% drop-off), voice-first profile building, smart appointment questions, Care Circle timing A/B, Ditto Chat concept, health integrations as signal layer, intent onboarding question. Cross-references existing ideas with new signals.

artifacts.title: Direction B: Speak to Ditto — Feature Considerations
artifacts.summary: Deep dive on Direction B from Onboarding to Aha. Cross-domain research (Fantastical, Noom, Flo, Ada Health), extraction reliability strategy (confirm-don't-assume), profile-to-content mapping architecture, must-have specs, and 6 open questions for Merlijn.

artifacts.title: 260320 - Product Strat

artifacts.title: User Awareness Mapping — Five Stages of Awareness (Schwartz)
artifacts.summary: Maps Ditto user segments against Schwartz's 5 awareness stages. Identifies P1 gap: can't differentiate users who don't understand vs don't need vs forget. Links initiatives to stages. Living document.

artifacts.title: User Profiling — Corrections & Documentation Gap Analysis
artifacts.summary: 7 corrections to canvas output. Root cause: documentation is behind shipped product state. Lists Confluence and local file updates needed. Process improvements for keeping docs in sync with shipped features.

artifacts.title: Push/Pull Calendar Integration
artifacts.summary: BIGB-235 Phase 1a complete. Push (Exploit, V1): add-to-calendar with deeplink back. Pull (Explore, V2): connect external calendar, auto-detect medical appointments, resolve empty state. Linked epic DPMA-1009. User-requested feature.

artifacts.title: Website Design Pattern Research
artifacts.summary: Structural analysis of 4 reference websites (Hims, Heidi Health, Tandem, Polarsteps). Covers site structure, hero approach, dual audience handling, CTA strategy, content patterns, and distinctiveness. Cross-site comparison table. Takeaways for Ditto Care website.

artifacts.title: Ditto Care Website Copy (Dutch) — Full Scrape
artifacts.summary: Complete Dutch copy from dittocare.com/nl and all 19 Dutch subpages. Organized by page with headings, body copy, CTAs, navigation, footer, App Store listing, and key statistics. Extracted via search index + partner pages due to Wix CSR.

artifacts.title: Recording Permission Support — Reducing the Fear Barrier
artifacts.summary: Feature idea: in-app permission script + printable doctor info sheet to help patients (esp. elderly, language barrier) overcome fear of asking to record. 4 directions, RISCE 540. Extends existing BIGB doctor explainer sheet idea.

artifacts.title: ZeroClaw — Claude-Powered Health Assistant JTBD Discovery
artifacts.summary: 37 jobs-to-be-done for Claude-powered personal health assistant, prioritized in 4 tiers. Claude capability assessment per job (native/augmented/hard limit). Key architectural principles from ZeroClaw/NanoClaw: persistent memory, scheduled tasks, agent specialization, tool use. Identifies 8 hard limits and 8 key risks. Top priority: contextual Q&A, audience-adapted sharing, living health profile.

artifacts.title: Care Brain Strategy — From Summarization to Care Intelligence Platform
artifacts.summary: Strategic spec superseding ZeroClaw. Critical review of 37-JTBD approach. April 2026 market intelligence. Model-agnostic care brain architecture with 7 bespoke interface surfaces. 6-month phased plan. Unicorn thesis: 'One recording, everyone understands.' Multi-perspective review from VC, Steve Jobs, patient.

artifacts.title: Smart Suggestions — Contextual Q&A on Summaries
artifacts.summary: Phase 1 of Care Brain. Smart suggestion chips below summaries: brain generates 2-3 contextual questions, user taps for grounded inline answers. Guided intelligence, not chatbot. A/B test plan. Targets 20%+ suggestion tap rate.

artifacts.title: Care Brain Business Case
artifacts.summary: Financial model, TAM (80-100M EU patients + 250-400M circle), revenue scenarios (B2C EUR 7.99/mo + B2B2C EUR 0.50-1.00 PMPM). AI cost $0.07/interaction, negligible at scale. Moat stack: care graph > journey history > trust > regulatory > network density. Path to unicorn at EUR 50-100M ARR (year 4-5). Persona critiques from VC, CTO, CMO, patient.

artifacts.title: Care Brain Competitive Analysis
artifacts.summary: Head-to-head analysis: ChatGPT Health, Copilot Health, Apple Health AI, Hippocratic AI, b.well bailey, Ambience, CaringBridge. Confirms no one builds audience-adapted health sharing for care circles. 18-24 month window before Big Tech adds social layer. Strategic implications: don't compete on individual Q&A, own the European care circle space.

artifacts.title: Care Brain Presentation — 20 Slides
artifacts.summary: Internal strategy deck. 20 slides: problem, current product, commoditization threat, market gap, vision, brain vs chatbot, concrete example, smart suggestions, 7 intelligence surfaces, unicorn feature, 3 architecture directions, moat stack, network effects, business model, GTM, roadmap, risks, the pitch.

artifacts.title: Direction A: The Concierge — Single Orchestrator Agent
artifacts.summary: Prototype-ready architecture spec for single-agent Care Brain direction. One Claude agent with rich system prompt and 8 MCP tools handles all brain operations. Full system prompt with identity, grounding rules, safety guardrails, audience adaptation rules. Health Profile JSON Schema with source attribution. 8 tool definitions (summarize, extract, suggest, answer, adapt, prep, patterns, translate). 3 end-to-end request flow scenarios. REST API contract with SSE streaming. Cost model: ~$0.94/user/month at scale. Prototype scope: 4 tools + CLI, 2-week build.

artifacts.title: Direction B: The Clinic — Multi-Agent Specialist Network
artifacts.summary: Prototype-ready architecture spec for multi-agent Care Brain direction. Orchestrator routes to 6 specialist agents (Summary, Extraction, Q&A, Sharing, Profile, Prep), each with dedicated system prompt, I/O schema, model selection, and quality guardrails. Health Profile Store with provenance, conflict detection, and versioning. 3 end-to-end request flow scenarios. Cost model: ~$0.18/appointment, 25-65% more than Direction A. Prototype scope: 3 agents (Summary, Extraction, Q&A) + CLI + eval harness, ~18 hours build.

artifacts.title: Direction C: The Nervous System — Event-Driven Reactive Architecture
artifacts.summary: Prototype-ready architecture spec for event-driven Care Brain direction. No central orchestrator. Events trigger processing pipelines. Health Profile Store as central nervous system. 8 event types, 7 pipeline definitions with step-by-step sequences, 9 stateless agent workers (summarize, extract, explain, suggest, answer, adapt, prep, detect_changes, translate) each with model selection, system prompts, I/O schemas. Full Health Profile JSON schema with versioning, audit log, conflict resolution. 3 end-to-end request flow scenarios with actual JSON payloads. Cost model: ~$0.124/user/month, lowest of 3 directions due to model-per-task optimization. 5-phase migration path from current Azure OpenAI architecture. Prototype scope: event emitter + SQLite + 4 core workers + CLI, 2-3 day build.

workflows.name: Feature Measurement

learnings.title: Shipping & Release Brainstorm
learnings.summary: Tables > subsections for meeting templates. Connect workflow outputs to inputs. Explore/Exploit/Polish drives communication strategy.

learnings.title: Jira Ticket Naming & Descriptions
learnings.summary: Don't repeat epic context in child ticket titles or descriptions. Jira shows the parent — keep titles short and action-oriented, descriptions jump straight into content.
